title: While Loops Practice
subject: Computer Science · Introduction to AI
instructions: Answer the three questions about while loops. Use the hints if you get stuck. Your teacher will review your work.

questions.prompt: What does this program print? Type the numbers separated by spaces.
questions.code:
n = 1
while n <= 3:
    print(n)
    n = n + 1

misconceptions.note: Is 3 <= 3 True? Check the condition again.

hints: Start with n = 1. Is n <= 3 True?
Write n after each turn of the loop. Stop when the condition is False.
A similar problem: with n <= 2 it prints 1 and 2. Now try n <= 3.

questions.prompt: What number does this program print?
questions.code:
count = 5
while count > 2:
    count = count - 1
print(count)

misconceptions.note: The loop keeps going while count > 2. What is count when that becomes False?

hints: Follow count step by step. What is it at the start?
Write down count after each turn, and check count > 2 each time.
A similar problem: start at 3 with count > 1 and you stop when count is 1. Try the same for this one.

questions.prompt: How many times does the loop body run?

misconceptions.note: 4 is the limit, not the number of turns. n goes up by 2 each turn.

hints: What does n start at, and how much does it grow each turn?
List the values of n at the start of each turn: 0, then the next one, and so on.
A similar problem: n = 0 and n = n + 1 with n < 3 runs 3 times. Count the turns for this one.
